authority: Prospective team-selected engineering goals; no instructor-mandated numerical recognition target was verified.

known_frontal_recognition.goal: At least 90% macro top-1 known identity on valid, single-face, frontal observations, with at least 90% identity-decision coverage.
known_frontal_recognition.rationale: Requires useful correct recognition and nontrivial coverage; report per-person confusion and reject/uncertain counts.

unseen_person_errors.goal: At most 1% false identification of genuinely unseen people at the frozen operating threshold; only met if the one-sided 95% upper confidence bound is also at or below 1%.
unseen_person_errors.minimum_evaluation_design: At least 300 held-out unknown encounters from at least 30 unseen identities, with identity-clustered uncertainty; report people, encounters, and images separately. Sparse evidence is inconclusive.
unseen_person_errors.rationale: Prevents a small unknown sample or reject-all behavior from appearing successful.

response_time.goal: At most 1.0 second p95 from camera capture timestamp to final system decision on the qualified standalone Nicla.
response_time.rationale: One-second response is a practical wearable interaction target and includes capture, detector, crop, identity and controller.

energy_quality.goal: Seek at least 10% lower whole-board energy per accepted correct known encounter than fixed-high cadence while keeping known macro top-1 loss within 5 percentage points and meeting the frozen unknown-error target.
energy_quality.design: At least ten independently started randomized paired physical blocks per contrast under the same qualified Nicla boundary and firmware/model/config hashes. Report paired effect and uncertainty.
energy_quality.rationale: Requires measurable efficiency improvement while preserving task quality; relative only after meter boundary and timing qualification.

reject_all_prohibition: Rejecting every input or chance-level known identity is not a successful recognizer.
physical_claim_gates: actual Nicla and exact firmware/model/config verified
fresh discovery and exclusive board lease
meter identity, power boundary, raw protocol and clock/timing qualified
